headline: Eveready launches liquid vaporisers to capture market share
hook: Eveready pivots into home insecticide segment
summary: Eveready Industries has officially entered the liquid vaporiser market, marking a diversification from its core battery and flashlight business. The company aims to secure a 2-4% market share in this new category. This move is part of a broader strategy to expand its presence in the household consumer goods space. The entry pits the legacy brand against established players in the competitive mosquito repellent sector.
why_it_matters: Diversification could improve long-term revenue growth for Eveready shareholders.
winners_losers: Eveready gains / Incumbent repellent brands face competition

headline: Eveready Industries expands into home-care with new liquid vaporiser
hook: Eveready pivots into home-care product market
summary: Eveready Industries is leveraging its existing battery distribution network to enter the home-care segment. The company has launched India's first portable liquid vaporiser as part of a broader product innovation strategy. CEO Anirban Banerjee stated that the move aims to diversify the company's portfolio beyond its core battery business. This expansion marks a strategic shift to capture market share in the household consumer goods category.
why_it_matters: Diversification could improve long-term revenue stability for Eveready shareholders.
winners_losers: Eveready gains / Home-care incumbents face competition
